describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile against a plain light background, with the overall body shape, fur, and proportions of a brown bear but with glossy beetle-like exoskeleton elements integrated into its surface. The body is covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the back and legs and lighter tan on the muzzle, chest, and underside. It stands on four thick legs ending in broad clawed paws and has a short furry tail at the rear. A single large, curved, glossy black horn projects from the forehead, and multiple hard, shiny dark brown and black plates resembling beetle elytra and pronotum are embedded along the back, sides, shoulders, throat, and around the leg joints. A row of small oval openings with dark rims is visible along the lower flank and on the throat.

describe.description: A large four-legged mammal with the overall shape, dense shaggy brown fur, head, ears, paws and short stub tail of a brown bear, shown in side view walking to the right. Its furry body is interspersed with glossy dark brown beetle exoskeleton: a large black-and-brown sculpted plate over the shoulders, paired ridged wing-covers on the mid-flank, smaller triangular plates on the back, rump and chest, and jointed plates around the leg joints, plus rows of small dark oval holes in the paler belly and neck fur. A single long curved toothed black beetle horn rises from its forehead between its small rounded bear ears.
